results.name: T1: (111) midplane cleanly separates FCC
results.details: Min distance to midplane: 2.886751e-01. Vertices above: 206, below: 50, on plane: 0. Unique layer heights: 11.

results.name: T2: Action decomposition: Tr(T^L) = Z_FCC for L = 1,2,3,5,8
results.details: Max relative error: 1.42e-16. Action decomposition consistent with diagonal transfer matrix.

results.name: T3: a_R(beta) > 0 for all R and all beta > 0
results.details: Tested 15 reps x 7 betas. Min a_R = 2.216000e-10. Violations: 0.

results.name: T4: lambda_R > 0 for all R, beta, N_s tested
results.details: Tested 12 reps x 5 betas x 3 N_s values. Min eigenvalue = 2.353092e-153.

results.name: T5: Self-adjointness: all eigenvalues real
results.details: Max |Im(a_R)/Re(a_R)| = 1.24e-14. All heat kernel coefficients have negligible imaginary parts.

results.name: T6: Charge conjugation: lambda_{(p,q)} = lambda_{(q,p)}
results.details: Max relative error: 3.35e-15. Tested 6 conjugate pairs at beta=4.0.

results.name: T8: Strong coupling: lambda_1 dominates
results.details: lambda_1 = 1.002237e+00, lambda_3/lambda_1 = 2.618264e-17, lambda_8/lambda_1 = 1.181723e-33. Trivial rep dominates at strong coupling.

results.name: T9: Weak coupling: u_R approaches 1 (reps equalize)
results.details: At beta=15.0: u_3 = 0.7396, mu = -0.8827. u_R ratios approach 1 at weak coupling (max deviation 0.5257).

results.name: T10: RP functional test: all contributions >= 0
results.details: Min RP contribution: 1.329352e-147. All spectral contributions to <conj(Theta F) * F> are non-negative.
